class.name: NetwLagCompensationConfig
class.brief_description: How long the server waits for a late player action, and how far ahead of itself it will take one.
class.description: Lag compensation starts automatically for [NetwPrediction] and [NetwAction]. Once applied, settings cannot change. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_lagcomp(self) \ .input_gate_deadline(16) \ .max_future_action(4) [/codeblock]

method.name: input_gate_deadline
method.description: Sets [member input_gate_deadline_ticks], how long an action waits for missing input.

method.name: max_future_action
method.description: Sets [member max_future_action_ticks], how far ahead of the server an action may be.

members.member: How many ticks a [constant NetwAction.TIMING_TICK_ALIGNED_STATE_READY] action waits for missing input before running anyway. Raise it for connections that lose packets often. Lower it to answer players sooner.
How many ticks ahead of the server an action may be. Further ahead is denied, so a client cannot claim it acted in the future.
